newsitem.title: NEPAL: Nepal's Chand wins confidence vote.
newsitem.headline: Nepal's Chand wins confidence vote.

text.p: Nepal's Prime Minister Lokendra Bahadur Chand on Wednesday won a vote of confidence in the Himalayan kingdom's parliament, officials said.
Parliament officials said Chand's week-old coalition that links formal royalists and communists won with 113 votes against the required minimum of 103 in the 205-seat House of Representatives.
"Since the figure in favour of the motion is adequate, in accordance with the constitution of the kingdom of Nepal, I declare the motion as passed," said speaker Ram Chandra Poudel.
Chand told reporters after the vote that he would soon expand his eight-member cabinet. He did not elaborate.
Chand took power in the world's only Hindu kingdom last week after a 17-month-old centre-right coalition, undermined by charges of corruption, narrowly lost a vote of confidence.
